summary: a private in-process plugin finishes the splash video playlist, posts the title's press-start command, closes the offline notice and skips the startup map through the game's own calls; with it, startup needs no input at all

mechanism.map: posts the game's own back-to-player flow event 1.5 s after the in-game flow event (same event the map's Back key posts)
mechanism.offline_notice: from the notice page's own UI-thread update, 1.5 s after it is pushed, queues the UI manager's close-top-page command (the call a sibling information box makes on accept)
mechanism.patching: per-class vtable slot swaps only, restored on unload; code pages are not modified
mechanism.title: 1 s after the title flow event, calls the game's frontend command entry with the press-start command; it posts the same chart event the title posts itself when a user is already assigned
mechanism.intro: 1 s after the intro state is entered, moves the splash player's playlist index to its end and sends one entry-ended event; the player runs its own finish path, which releases the intro state

sessions.note: no key presses before gameplay; intros played in full (no Escape); title never seen by OCR
failed intro skip: called the intro's own finished callback, but its flag was already set; the intro waits for the splash player instead
no key presses; the intro video stopped (no lingering video, observed by the user); title never seen by OCR

screens_not_shown: title (press-start posted 1 s after it is entered)
failed_attempts_before_this: calling the notice's input handler from another thread: no player read afterwards (later traced to the navigator not reading the player in hands-off runs)
accept action, cancel action and a replayed raw Enter (traced from a real press) on the UI thread: handler returned 0, notice stayed
the notice's own close method is an empty stub for this box
navigator bug: hands-off runs sent no menu input, so the player was never read; fixed by reading after a loading or post-title screen
limits: one fully native pass (x28) and one input-free pass with full intros (x26); build-specific; the plugin stays private; same map and spawn as the normal flow
screens_shortened: intro videos (finished 1 s after the intro state starts)
